project_type: OpenMatrix9 standalone Rust workspace (eframe/egui 0.36.2 + wgpu desktop CAD shell), Windows, PowerShell
language: Rust (safe). Python only for tool launchers (tools/validate_standalone_ui.py precedent). Skill text is Vietnamese.
build_system: cargo workspace at h:\OpenMatrix9\standalone (all cargo commands run there). Binary: standalone\target\debug\om9.exe (crate om9-app, bin om9). Use ';' not '&&' in PowerShell.
test_framework: cargo test (built-in). Integration tests in standalone/crates/om9-app/tests/*.rs drive MatrixApp through headless egui (context.run_ui with RawInput.screen_rect). Lib tests inside src/workbench_regions.rs.
test_command: cargo test -p om9-app ; cargo test --workspace   (cwd h:\OpenMatrix9\standalone)
verification_instructions: cargo fmt --all -- --check ; cargo check --workspace --all-targets ; cargo build --workspace ; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings ; cargo test --workspace. Real-window audit: om9.exe --ui-audit <dir> with env OM9_UI_AUDIT_WINDOW=WxH, OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK=1 (and new OM9_UI_AUDIT_ZOOM); writes workspace.png and ui-receipt.json then exits 0 (21 passes). View every screenshot you cite with the image reader.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Evidence logs go to implementation/evidence/M01/OM9-L3-01-01-002/. Screenshots go to build/standalone-validation/ui-artifacts/<YYYY-MM-DD>-m01-l3-002-closeout/ (new dated folder, never overwrite 2026-10-16-m01-l3-002-docking). Scoped-audit mirror goes to build/scoped-audit/. No generated files are checked in by build/test.
environment_constraints: NEVER commit, push or stage. NEVER edit, move, delete or stage ref\, manuals\, OM9_Milestones\, QymCAD\, vendor-research\, om9-window.png (OM9_Milestones has user-staged renames; leave them alone). QymCAD is a code-sample source only: no copying, no Cargo dependency. Never claim M01-UI, M00 or legal gates passed; keep reviewer.status NOT_SIGNED. Do not implement OM9-L2-01-02 / OM9-L2-01-03. Primary display 2560x1440 (work area 1392 tall), second monitor 1080x1920 at x=2560. OS min window 720x480 (AppConfig.min_window). The full python tools\public_source_audit.py exits 1 with ~11721 errors in private trees; never claim it passed and never change its behaviour.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: Rust first; evidence-only status; update live ledger docs/openmatrix9-progress.json with evidence, uncertainties and next action; business-rule changes go to skills only with consent (consent given for the four behaviours in final-report-vi.md); record Rust-first exceptions (the Python matrix runner) with reason; run public_source_audit scoped only; preserve notices. docs/AGENTS.md: keep legacy vs standalone evidence explicit.
key_patterns: Pure model workbench_regions.rs (compute_regions, RegionPlan::validate, RegionError, RegionNote). ui.rs refresh_region_plan/announce_regions each frame; status panel egui::Panel::bottom("matrix-status") records status_rect; ui/chrome.rs::status_bar_ui draws message label plus a nested right_to_left layout (Dismiss button, dock_summary label) with no width limit - this is the overlap. Audit-only env vars are parsed in ui.rs launch_classified/launch_with and fail visibly with StartupFailure. Frame test helper pattern: tests/workbench_regions.rs frame_size/startup/assert_no_overlap.
directory_structure: standalone/ (cargo workspace, crates/om9-app = shell), implementation/{design,fixtures,evidence}/M01/OM9-L3-01-01-002/ (L4 artefacts), docs/ (ledger + validation), skills/ (repo skills), tools/ (python tools), build/ (generated evidence, excluded by the audit), OM9_Milestones/ (protected plan tree; L3-002 at 'OM9_Milestones/M01 - CAD Shell, Viewport/L2-01-01 - Febe Application Shell Docking/L3-002 - Workbench Docking Regions/'), .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/ (task notes).
